name: Filipino Home Kitchen
summary: Sinigang, tinola, monggo and pinakbet from Lola's kitchen.

foods.name: Sinigang
foods.blurb: Sour tamarind soup with vegetables and pork or fish.

foods.name: Tinola
foods.blurb: Chicken and ginger soup with green papaya and malunggay leaves.

foods.name: Ginisang Monggo
foods.blurb: Mung bean stew with greens, every Friday in many homes.

foods.name: Pinakbet
foods.blurb: Squash, okra, eggplant and bitter melon with a little shrimp paste.

foods.name: Arroz Caldo
foods.blurb: Ginger-chicken rice porridge for rainy days.

foods.name: Halo-Halo
foods.blurb: Shaved ice with sweet beans, jelly and milk. Sometimes!
